name: Spotted in Prod
summary: Gallery of standout iOS apps and interactions, filterable by style, UI pattern, industry and maker.
description: A curated gallery of standout iOS apps and interactions. Each app is tagged across six groups: visual style (minimal, skeuomorphism, liquid glass …), content and effects, interaction (tap, scroll, drag, gyroscope …), UI pattern (modal, bottom sheet, carousel, toast …), industry and maker type. A separate Clips feed collects individual interaction clips that link back to their apps.
